Chapter 11

Chapter 11: Shopping; The Perfect Prince Charming!

Guojin Center was beautifully decorated and fashionable. It was full of people and very lively.

Lin Fan and the rest took the escalator and went straight to Cartier.

“Welcome to Cartier!” A sweet-looking employee stood at the entrance of the store and welcomed them politely.

“How may I help you?” the shop assistant asked.

“I’m here to get my earrings,” Wan Yuerou said.

As she spoke, Wan Yuerou took out a receipt.

“Alright, please wait a moment,” the shop assistant said.

Then, she handed the receipt to the staff member standing in front of the cashier.

Women were naturally attracted to jewelry.

After Huang Moli entered Cartier, she started to look around.

However, she did not dare to look at the big pieces of jewelry because the prices were too frightening.

She only pointed at some small accessories and could not help but praise them.

“Woah! This bracelet is so pretty!” Huang Moli said.

“It’s really beautiful!” Wan Yuerou said.

“This is a Cartier LOVE bracelet, ” the shop assistant introduced with a smile. “It was designed by the famous designer, Hunter Buk.

“There are seven different styles of LOVE bracelets. They’re like rainbows-bright, colorful, and full of energy.”

Huang Moli and Wan Yuerou were already extremely fond of the bracelet. After hearing the shop assistant’s explanation, their eyes lit up.

“Seven different styles! Even if each of the four of us in the dormitory buys one, it’d be completely different!” Wan Yuerou said excitedly.

Then, the shop assistant pointed at an extremely gorgeous necklace displayed in the counter and said, “Not long ago, Hunter Buk designed the Star of the Deep Sea. It’s like a star hidden in the deep sea, mysterious and dazzling!

“Because of this Star of the Deep Sea, Hunter Buk has also won the love of countless people in international exhibitions!”

Qin Yuxuan followed the shop assistant’s finger, and her eyes lit up.

It was obvious that she liked the necklace.

“Yuxuan, I’ve never given you a present before. I’ll give you this necklace, then,” Lin Fan said.

When the shop assistant heard this, she hurriedly said, “Sir, your taste is really great! This beautiful lady is just as mysterious, dazzling, and eye-catching in the crowd as the necklace.

“If she wears the Star of the Deep Sea, they would simply complement each other!”

Qin Yuxuan shook her head and said, “I just do research at the university every day. There’s no need for me to wear this necklace.”

This necklace must be very expensive.

Qin Yuxuan did not think that Lin Fan could not afford it.

However, she did not want Lin Fan to think that she was vain.

The shop assistant sighed in her heart, ‘Someone wants to give you such a beautiful necklace, yet you don’t want it?’

“How much does this Star of the Deep Sea cost?” Huang Moli asked.

“The main body of the Star of the Deep Sea is made of two carats of blue diamond, which is the only one in the entire Modu City. And its price is 1.08 million,” the shop assistant said.

“It’s that expensive?” Huang Moli asked in surprise.

Although she had already expected the price of this necklace to be very expensive, she did not expect such an astronomical price.

A necklace like that was enough to buy a luxury car.

Wan Yuerou was also shocked by the price and asked, “What about the LOVE bracelets?”

“The LOVE bracelets are 58,888 bucks each,” the shop assistant said.

When Wan Yuerou and Huang Moli heard this price, their faces revealed a dejected look.

58,888 yuan! It was close to 60,000 yuan!

They were only students now.

Perhaps they could fork out this sum of money in the future.

However, it was very difficult for them to do so now.

Therefore, even though the two of them liked it, they had no choice but to give it up.

At this moment, Wan Yuerou received her earrings.

“Miss, do you need me to help you wrap up your earrings?” the shop assistant asked with a smile.

“Yes, wrap them up,” Wan Yuerou said.

Then, they continued to stroll around Guojin Center.

Lin Fan found an opportunity to go to the washroom, but he actually returned to Cartier.

The shop assistant recognized him at a glance and greeted him with a smile, “Sir, what can I do for you?”

“I want the Star of the Deep Sea and four LOVE bracelets,” Lin Fan said.

Four LOVE bracelets and one Star of the Deep Sea… This was a big order of more than 1.3 million!

The shop assistant’s heart began to beat wildly.

“Alright, I’ll wrap them up for you!” she said excitedly.

Lin Fan waved his hand and said, “No need. Just give them to me.”

“Alright,” she said. The shop assistant quickly responded, then took out a calculator and fiddled with it. “The total is 1,315,552 yuan. I can give you a 10% discount…”

“No need, just take the discount as your tip,” Lin Fan said. Then, he took out his bank card.

The shop assistant’s service attitude was very good, and she was good at introducing the jewelry too.

More importantly, she picked out a necklace that Qin Yuxuan liked.

Therefore, she should be rewarded.

The shop assistant’s heart started to race again.

The discount would be her tip!

This was a deal worth more than 1.3 million yuan!

Even at the very least, the discount would be more than 10,000!

Now, all of that was hers?

The shop assistant spent a lot of effort to suppress the excitement in her heart and said, “Thank you, sir, thank you!”

[Ding! You have spent 1,315,552 yuan. Do you want to use the 10x return card?]

‘Yes!’ Lin Fan muttered in his heart.

[Ding! System upgrade: Level 4!]

[Level 4 reward: 10 yuan for every breath; 10 yuan for every second of sleep; 10 yuan for every step taken. Rewards are distributed at 12 a.m. daily.]

[Upgrade cost: 660000/10 million (not including gifts and gambling. In addition, all items obtained from the system are prohibited from being traded.]

The guaranteed cash he received every day doubled again, reaching about 700,000 yuan.

Then, his phone vibrated.

[Notice from China Merchant Bank: 13,155,520 yuan has been deposited into your account.]

He received 13.15 million yuan directly!

After Lin Fan took the five pieces of jewelry, he returned to Qin Yuxuan’s side as if nothing had happened.

Women naturally loved to shop.

However, the things in the Guojin Center were too expensive and far beyond their spending ability.

The feeling of seeing something you like but not being able to pay for it and having no choice but to leave was too unbearable.

Therefore, after walking around for a while, they suggested that they leave.

“Lin Fan, I might not be able to accompany you tonight. I have to go back to the dormitory to prepare some materials for tomorrow’s project.”

Lin Fan nodded. “Okay, but don’t tire yourself out. Take care of your health.”

After sharing some sweet words, the two of them separated.

…

In the dormitory of Modu University…

“Hurry up and tell me, how’s Yuxuan’s boyfriend?” Zhang Jin asked impatiently.

“One word-handsome!” Huang Moli said.

“Two words-very handsome!” Wan Yuerou said.

“It’s all my supervisor’s fault for suddenly working overtime today!” Zhang Jing said regretfully. “I missed the chance to see a handsome guy!”

Qin Yuxuan shook her head as she looked at her roommates’ funny faces.

Out of habit, she opened her bag and took out her phone.

The next moment, Qin Yuxuan took out a bunch of accessories and asked, “Why are these in my bag?”

“The LOVE bracelets!” Huang Moli cried out in surprise.

“And the Heart of the Deep Sea!” Wan Yuerou shouted.

Huang Moli said, “I know! Lin Fan must have bought them when he went to the washroom and secretly put them in your bag!”

“Heavens! He easily bought a million-yuan piece of jewelry and then secretly gave it away! Moreover, he’s so handsome! Gosh… He’s the perfect man!” Wan Yuerou shouted.

Huang Moli cried out, “I finally understand now why Yuxuan rejected all those handsome guys and young masters in the university. If I had such a perfect Prince Charming, I’d definitely treat those guys like too!”

Wan Yuerou asked, “Yuxuan, does your boyfriend have an older or younger brother? Please introduce me to them!”

“Me too, me too! I want to be introduced to them too!” Huang Moli said.

“Me too, please introduce me!” Zhang Jin said.

Qin Yuxuan was amused by them and said, “It’s a pity that he only has one sister.”

As soon as she said that, the three of them were extremely depressed.

“He doesn’t have a brother, but you guys can have a bracelet,” Qin Yuxuan said.

As she spoke, Qin Yuxuan took out three LOVE bracelets.
